text:
leo_infra: looping in @gcp_sales — they proposed 60% off committed GPU capacity but flagged availability as "best-effort" in us-west1. Do we push for a regional availability warrant or accept preemptible offsets? cc @nina_finance @marta_sre

nina_finance: we can take the discount, but we need invoice protection. ask for: outage credits, carry-forward for unused committed hours, and per-GPU metering so our reconciler can map charges to fleet usage.

marta_sre: +1 on telemetry hooks. if they don't guarantee locality we risk cross-AZ eviction and massive KV cache churn. need a burst bucket + preemptible-swap policy in the contract.

gcp_sales: quick update from my side — we can propose a Regional Capacity Warrant (RCW) as a commercial addendum: 95% allocated-hours availability per month for committed quota. For preemption above threshold we can provide credits. Not standard but negotiable with approvals.

leo_infra: can you get concrete language? we want the metric spelled out. e.g.:
```
availability = allocated_gpu_hours / committed_gpu_hours
if availability < 0.95:
  credits = (0.95 - availability) * monthly_commitment * 0.5
```
That gives legal something to quantify.

sam_cloud_sales: also push for AZ anchoring clause — "locality guarantee" so that allocated GPUs remain in the same AZ for >95% of allocation time. otherwise ML latency profile and caching regress.

nina_finance: ramp terms: we need a 6-month linear ramp (25/50/75/100) or a proportional billing carveout if we scale slower. include a break clause if their spot pricing / marketplace deviate by >10% from baseline.

leo_infra: operational ask: expose an hourly allocation API/metric (allocated_hours, preempted_hours, scheduled_maintenance_hours) so we can automate credits and failover. Also require 90-day invoice lookback for disputed charges.

gcp_sales: understood. i'll pull a draft RCW + telemetry schema and sample credit calc by EOD tomorrow and share a doc.

billing-bot: flagged invoice #INV-2026-02-1145 for review — possible double-billed GPU hours in us-west1 for period 2026-02-10 to 2026-02-12. tagging @nina_finance.

nina_finance: thanks, will reconcile and add as leverage in talks if pattern shows poor availability.

leo_infra: action items: 1) @gcp_sales share RCW draft + metrics (EOD tomorrow). 2) @marta_sre list telemetry endpoints we need. 3) @nina_finance prepare negotiation deck with invoice examples and desired credit formula. i'll assemble redlines for legal after draft lands. :+1:

gcp_sales: will do — expecting to escalate internally for RCW signoff.

marta_sre: quick note — when they send draft, confirm maintenance windows are excluded from availability calc and that "allocation" means GPUs attached and ready-to-serve (not just reserved).

leo_infra: perfect. will call out exclusions in redlines. thanks all.
